checks.observation: Blank form gives email/password feedback; protected screen is not shown.
Student identity and three Pending checklist items visible.
Submission transitions to Submitted and approved count remains zero.
Blank note shows actionable validation; valid note returns requirement.
Returned item and correction text appear on student checklist.
Actual readiness200 ->503 ->200 after controlled DB config failure/recovery.
Resubmit/approve loop preserves staff authority and updates student result.
Student result renders at narrow viewport; no full accessibility certification inferred.
Sign-out returns to login; token revocation separately verified by API tests.
